items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: But I think I even spoke to Milt about it or one of them — or Panama Francis.

ctx.x: But he comes into the room and, “did you have the baby” or something like that. “Yeah. We had a boy.” So that was the beginning. And then we had Martin after that so we had two girls first and then the two boys. But I think I even spoke to Milt about it or one of them — or Panama Francis. Yeah. I said, “you know I had the baby.”
And Bucky was with you, right?
